items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: Now, I remember when he was a little small kid, living on Saratoga in Potters.

ctx.x: But he was very... He wasn't born, I believe, when he was coming out. No. No. Lewis used to work for W.G. Carl Coop. Now, I remember when he was a little small kid, living on Saratoga in Potters. Well, of course, them days, we didn't know nothing about Lewis, but Lewis started at home. They tell me.
How about your other brothers and sisters? Did they ever play anything?
